Hong Kong: a 23.34-carat fancy-yellow diamond led Phillips' Hong Kong Jewels Auction at HK$4.3 million, in line with its high estimate, while two of the other top five lots sold under their low estimate.

香港：一枚23.34卡拉艷彩黃鑽以港幣430萬元成交，價格與估價上限相符，領銜富藝斯（Phillips）香港珠寶拍賣；同場五大拍品中，另有兩件低於估價下限成交。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Gold in Hong Kong tonight: HK$39,344 a tael, HK$1,051 a gram, silver HK$15,277 a kilogram, from the tape's 30 September intraday mark.
